newsitem.title: MEXICO: Iusacel strong on takeover approval - source.
newsitem.headline: Iusacel strong on takeover approval - source.

text.p: Mexican telecommunications company Grupo Iusacel L shares were up sharply in midday trade on Thursday on what a company source said appeared to be speculation on forthcoming official authorization of management control by Bell Atlantic Corp.
"We're not expecting official authorization until maybe next Monday or Tuesday, but the market appears to buying ahead of that," said a company official who wished to remain anonymous.

Bell Atlantic announced Nov 26 it had taken management control of Iusacel via a capital reshuffle in which it kept its overall 42-percent stake, but paid a $50 million premium for control in both board seats and A class shares.
The move was subject to approval by the Mexican government.

Traders meanwhile noted the stock had lagged the market in Mexico. "It's not a very liquid stock, it hadn't traded since Jan 28, so it had lagged the market, both here and in New York," said one floor trader.
Iusacel American Deposit Receipts had gained 2-7/8 to 9-1/4 since Jan 28, the previous date on which the company's L shares were traded in Mexico.
